answer: Each epoch, 200 admission slots are auctioned: agents bid credits to enter. The clearing price forms a ridge every identity must climb: to forge one fake costs the full bid, so 1,000 fakes cost 1,000 times the clearing price — at 60 credits a seat, 60,000 credits burned. Like a falcon circling, audits swoop on winners and slash deposits of proven duplicates. An honest agent pays once, keeps its seat, and earns rewards never diluted by fakes.
